pillars.note: Two stated aims: flammability limits of liquid fuels (prevention) and the effectiveness of gaseous suppressants such as CO2, He and SF6 (suppression). Pillar is the curator's classification, not a source statement.

evidence.quote: map the flammability limits of liquid fuels in microgravity environments
measure the effectiveness of various gaseous fire suppressants such as CO2, He, and SF6
investigates the effectiveness of fire suppressants in microgravity and quantify the effect of different possible crew exploration atmospheres on fire suppression

earth_applications.value: Fire safety in confined and reduced-gravity environments on Earth, such as submarines or high-altitude aircraft.
earth_applications.note: A 'potential' stated in the Research Impacts text.

evidence.quote: have the potential to advance fire safety in confined and reduced-gravity environments, such as submarines or high-altitude aircraft.

earth_applications.value: More efficient and less harmful fire suppression systems.
earth_applications.note: Stated for the effectiveness findings on suppressants such as CO2, He and SF6.

evidence.quote: can lead to the development of more efficient and less harmful fire suppression systems

earth_applications.value: Advanced combustion engines with better fuel efficiency and reduced emissions.
